Name: Chaste Valley
Author: TensorC
Description:
[b]Chaste Valley [/b]adds chastity punishments to your game by adding time to your locks on [url=https://chaster.app/]Chaster[/url].

[size=5][b]Chaster Access[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Sign in to your account
[*]Go to the [url=https://chaster.app/developers]Developers[/url]﻿ portal, scroll down and request API access

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/110089673-1712421267.png[/img]﻿[*]On the next page you'll need to fill out these fields:
[list]
[*][b]Email:[/b] The email you use for your Chaster account
[*][b]Name: [/b]Use your Chaster display name
[*][b]What API to use?:[/b] Public API
[*][b]Application Description:[/b] Mod integration
[/list][*]You'll receive an email in about 5-10 minutes, at which point you'll be able to access the [url=https://chaster.app/developers/applications]Developer Interface[/url]﻿, go there now and create a new application

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/110089673-1712421336.png[/img]﻿[*]Enter any name (e.g., "Application") and Save changes
[*]Go to Tokens and Generate a developer token

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/110089673-1712421381.png[/img]﻿[*]You'll see a long string of random characters, copy and save it somewhere as you'll need it later
[/list]

[b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Edit config.json in the mod folder and set ChasterAuthToken
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][size=5]Usage
[/size][/b]Create a self lock on Chaster or join any shared lock. Whenever time is added in the game, it will be added to EVERY lock you are currently in. If you are using a self lock I would recommend enabling offer session and the hygiene opening extension since the mod has no way of removing time.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
You will have noticed several settings in the config file and I will briefly explain what each of them does

[list]
[*][b]HoursForDying[/b]
How many hours will be added to your lock if you die[*][b]HoursForFainting[/b]
How many hours are added if you faint from running out of stamina or staying up too late[*][b]HoursForDamagedCommunityCenter[/b]
Hours added each night that you have not completed the community center (I hope you didn't go the JojaMart route!)[*][b]HoursForMissingMoneyPerDayGoal[/b]
Hours added if you do not meet your daily income goals[*][b]MoneyPerDayGoalIncrement[/b]
How much money you must make each day to avoid punishment (e.g., if set to 20 then you'll need to make 20G on Day 1, 40G on Day 2, etc.)[*][b]MaxMoneyPerDayGoal[/b]
The cap on how much money you'll need to earn each day to avoid punishment[/list]
Any of the penalties can be set to 0 to disable them
